---
name: Experiment or replication
about: Report complete independently obtained outcomes or propose a specified experiment
title: '[Replication / Experiment] '
labels: research
---

## Goal and status

Is this a completed replication, held-out validation, or proposal? State the hypothesis before outcomes where possible.

## Environment and provenance

Hardware/OS, Python/package versions, model/head/runtime revisions and hashes, actual tensor types, driver/protocol revision.

## Protocol and data

Exact saved seed manifest, initial board, question/features, action policy, cap, model execution order, and all deviations. Link all per-round results and complete request/response logs with integrity checks (no credentials or private paths).

## Outcomes and verification

All scores, paired differences, collisions/caps, offline audit result, uncertainty method, and failures. Do not treat correlated moves as independent skill observations or discard unfavorable seeds.

## Interpretation and limitations

Precision/runtime/order differences; reused discovery versus genuinely held-out seeds; what the evidence does and does not establish.
